words.intro: His memories are hiding in the letters.
words.foundText: Take the memory back to Eli.
words.carryText: It was a lab. There were other children. My mother was there.

memories.reveal: cold white lights reflected on a metal table
memories.line: I thought it was our house… but those lights were too bright. It was a lab.

memories.reveal: small beds behind curtains, each marked with a number
memories.line: There were other children there. I could hear them breathing, but I never saw their faces.

memories.reveal: a woman holding his hand and whispering his name
memories.line: My mother was there. She was holding my hand… and she wouldn’t let go.
